children.value: > Fact From Story: This week marked OpenAI’s first-ever dev conference, where the Microsoft-backed AI startup announced a host of new products.
> > Fact From Story: OpenAI hosted its first-ever developer conference on Monday, and the company had a lot to talk about.
> > > Fact From Story: OpenAI threw a dev day.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A dev day is a developer conference.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A conference is an event where people gather to discuss a topic.
